_doc: F1 — AHASD reference overlay plus SSRC (Speculative State Rollback Control). Identical to ahasd_full otherwise; the confidence threshold (6.0f) is deliberately below the synthetic hint's ceiling (~5.0 early / ~5.0+jitter late) so pilot runs can exercise the 'refuse to defer' and 'partial accept' branches as well as the happy path. Production sweeps override the threshold via --config-override ssrc_confidence_threshold=...
